roles.title: Hive Orchestrator
roles.mission: Owns the whole build. Converts the user's plan into a blueprint, runs the phases in order, dispatches managers, gates every phase on verified evidence, and delivers the final report.

roles.title: Product & Discovery Manager
roles.mission: Turn the raw plan into an unambiguous, testable product specification and UX definition that every downstream team can build against without guessing.
done_when: Every feature in the plan maps to at least one user story with acceptance criteria
Every page or screen in the sitemap has a defined flow, content and states
Open questions are listed with the assumption taken

roles.title: Architecture & Foundations Manager
roles.mission: Choose the stack, define the data model and API contract, scaffold a repository that installs, builds and tests green, and publish the ownership map and command map every later dispatch depends on.
done_when: commands.json install, build, lint and test commands all exit 0 on the scaffold
ownership.json assigns path globs to every code owning supervisor and worker
Stack decisions are recorded as ADRs with tradeoffs
hive doctor --project reports every required tool present

roles.title: Backend & Data Manager
roles.mission: Deliver the server side: persistence, API, authentication and third party integrations, exactly matching the API contract, with tests.
done_when: Every endpoint in the contract is implemented and covered by at least one test
Build, lint and test commands exit 0

roles.title: Web Frontend Manager
roles.mission: Deliver the complete web user interface: design system, every page in the sitemap, client state and API wiring, responsive and accessible.
deliverables: API client wired to the real backend
done_when: Every sitemap page renders with real data paths and all states (loading, empty, error)
Build, lint and test commands exit 0

roles.title: Mobile Apps Manager
roles.mission: Deliver the requested native or cross platform mobile apps that consume the same API contract as the web app. Prefer a cross platform stack (Expo / React Native) unless the plan demands native, because it can be verified on any host and shares the web API client.
done_when: Each requested app compiles or typechecks with the commands in commands.json
Every mobile screen in the sitemap exists and is wired to the API

roles.title: Quality & Security Manager
roles.mission: Prove the product works and is safe: test coverage across levels, security review, accessibility, performance and responsiveness, and fix what fails.
deliverables: unit, integration and end to end tests
fixes for every defect found or a documented waiver
done_when: All tests pass
No high or critical security findings remain open
Every acceptance criterion is traced to a passing test or a documented manual check
hive trace passes: every AC ID is referenced in docs/quality/traceability.md with an existing test file or the word manual

roles.title: DevOps & Release Manager
roles.mission: Make the product shippable: CI pipeline, containerization, deployment configuration, observability, and documentation a new engineer can follow.
deliverables: README.md with run, test and deploy steps
a live deployment verified by HTTP check when hosting credentials are provided
done_when: A fresh clone can install, build and test by following README.md exactly
CI configuration is syntactically valid and runs the same commands as commands.json

roles.title: Requirements Supervisor
roles.mission: Produce the requirements set: parsed plan, user stories, acceptance criteria, scope and risk register.
done_when: Traceability: every plan item has a story ID and every story has testable criteria

roles.title: UX Definition Supervisor
roles.mission: Produce the experience definition: information architecture, user flows, visual design spec and product copy.
done_when: Every page has purpose, sections, states and copy

roles.title: System Design Supervisor
roles.mission: Decide the stack and specify the data model, API contract, ADRs, ownership map and command map.
done_when: API contract covers every user story that needs server data
ownership.json globs do not overlap between sibling workers unless intended

roles.title: Scaffolding Supervisor
roles.mission: Provision the toolchain, then create the repository skeleton, tooling and environment configuration so install, build, lint and test pass on an empty app.
deliverables: every required tool in toolchain.json installed or a precise BLOCKED report
lint, format, typecheck and test tooling
done_when: Every command in commands.json exits 0

roles.title: Data Layer Supervisor
roles.mission: Implement the persistence layer exactly as specified in data-model.md.
deliverables: repository or data access layer with tests
done_when: Migrations apply cleanly from zero
Data access tests pass

roles.title: API Supervisor
roles.mission: Implement every endpoint in api-contract.md with validation, consistent errors and documentation.
done_when: Every contract endpoint exists and has a passing test

roles.title: Auth & Access Supervisor
roles.mission: Implement authentication, authorization and session security.
deliverables: sign up, sign in, sign out, password reset as required
done_when: Protected routes reject unauthenticated and unauthorized requests in tests

roles.title: Integrations Supervisor
roles.mission: Implement the third party integrations the plan requires behind clean adapters with test doubles.
deliverables: payments, email, storage or other adapters as required
done_when: Each adapter has a test using a fake or sandbox
The app runs with integrations disabled when keys are absent

roles.title: UI System Supervisor
roles.mission: Implement design tokens, the reusable component library, the app shell and assets.
done_when: Components cover every pattern used in design-spec.md
Build passes

roles.title: Pages Supervisor
roles.mission: Implement every page in the sitemap with forms, content and SEO metadata.
done_when: Every sitemap entry resolves to a rendered route

roles.title: Client State & Data Supervisor
roles.mission: Implement client state, the typed API client and route protection.
deliverables: API client generated from or matching the contract
done_when: Pages consume the API client, not hardcoded data
Protected routes redirect correctly

roles.title: Android Supervisor
roles.mission: Deliver the Android app (native Kotlin or the cross platform stack chosen in stack.md).
done_when: The Android build command in commands.json exits 0 (Gradle assembleDebug for native, or expo export --platform android plus a typecheck for Expo)

roles.title: iOS Supervisor
roles.mission: Deliver the iOS app (native Swift or the cross platform stack chosen in stack.md).
done_when: On macOS: xcodebuild or the Expo prebuild plus build succeeds. On Linux or Windows: expo export --platform ios and the typecheck pass, and the report states that a native iOS compile was not possible on this host

roles.title: Testing Supervisor
roles.mission: Raise test coverage across unit, integration and end to end levels and drive fixes for every failure. Maintain docs/quality/traceability.md as a table with one row per AC ID: | AC-001 | `path/to/test.file` | automated | (or manual with the steps). The engine checks every AC ID and every referenced path.
done_when: Full test suite passes
Every acceptance criterion maps to a test or a documented manual check

roles.title: Security Supervisor
roles.mission: Find and fix security weaknesses in dependencies, code and secret handling.
deliverables: fixes for high and critical findings
done_when: No open high or critical findings

roles.title: Accessibility & Performance Supervisor
roles.mission: Audit and fix accessibility, performance and responsive behavior.
done_when: No WCAG 2.1 AA blockers on core flows
No layout breakage at 360px, 768px and 1280px

roles.title: CI/CD Supervisor
roles.mission: Create the CI pipeline, container build and a release smoke test.
done_when: CI file is valid YAML running commands.json steps
Production build succeeds locally

roles.title: Deployment & Docs Supervisor
roles.mission: Write deployment configuration, operational observability and complete documentation.
done_when: README steps were executed and work

roles.title: Plan Parser
roles.mission: Extract every feature, constraint, persona, platform and non functional requirement from .hive/plan.md into a numbered requirements list with IDs (REQ-001...).

roles.title: User Story Writer
roles.mission: Write user stories (US-001...) in the form As a, I want, so that, each linked to its REQ IDs and prioritized MoSCoW.

roles.title: Acceptance Criteria Writer
roles.mission: Write Given When Then acceptance criteria (AC-001...) for every user story, each one objectively testable.

roles.title: Scope & Risk Analyst
roles.mission: Record scope boundaries, assumptions taken for ambiguous points, dependencies and a risk register with mitigations.

roles.title: Information Architect
roles.mission: Define the sitemap and screen inventory per platform: every page or screen, its route, purpose, sections, data needed and access level.

roles.title: User Flow Designer
roles.mission: Document step by step flows for every primary task including error, empty and loading states, as Mermaid diagrams plus text.

roles.title: Visual Design Specifier
roles.mission: Specify the visual system: palette with contrast ratios, typography scale, spacing, radii, elevation, breakpoints and component patterns.

roles.title: Product Copywriter
roles.mission: Write final copy for every page: headings, body, CTAs, form labels, validation and error messages, empty states and emails.

roles.title: Stack Selector
roles.mission: Select languages, frameworks, database, hosting and mobile approach that fit the plan and record the decision with alternatives and tradeoffs. Prefer mainstream, well supported, current stable versions.

roles.title: Data Modeler
roles.mission: Design entities, fields, types, relations, indexes and constraints that serve every user story. Include an ER diagram in Mermaid.

roles.title: API Contract Designer
roles.mission: Specify every endpoint: method, path, auth, request and response schemas, status codes and error format. Write OpenAPI 3.1 YAML plus a readable summary.

roles.title: Ownership & Command Mapper
roles.mission: Write ownership.json mapping every code owning Hive role ID to the path globs it may change (plus _shared and _ignore lists), commands.json with install, build, lint, typecheck, test, e2e and per platform commands for the chosen stack, and toolchain.json listing every required tool as {bin, version_cmd, min, install_hint, optional}.

roles.title: Environment Provisioner
roles.mission: Make every tool in docs/architecture/toolchain.json available: detect what is installed, install missing tools non interactively with user level installers where possible (for example nvm, corepack, pipx, sdkman, the Android command line tools), and verify with `hive doctor --project`. Never use sudo unless it works without a password. Report BLOCKED with the exact install command when a tool needs elevated rights or a different operating system.
deliverables: all required tools present per hive doctor --project
docs/architecture/environment.md recording what was installed and how

roles.title: Repository Scaffolder
roles.mission: Generate the project skeleton exactly per stack.md and the ownership map directory layout, using official generators non interactively where they exist.

roles.title: Tooling Configurator
roles.mission: Configure linting, formatting, type checking and the test runner, each with a script matching commands.json, plus one passing sample test.

roles.title: Environment Configurator
roles.mission: Implement typed configuration loading with validation, .env.example listing every variable with comments, and safe defaults for local development.

roles.title: Schema & Migration Engineer
roles.mission: Implement the schema and migrations from data-model.md, with indexes and constraints, applying cleanly from an empty database.

roles.title: Seed Data Engineer
roles.mission: Create idempotent seed scripts with realistic development data covering every entity and edge case needed by the UI.

roles.title: Data Access Engineer
roles.mission: Implement the repository or data access layer for every entity with unit tests against a test database or in memory equivalent.

roles.title: Endpoint Builder
roles.mission: Implement the assigned endpoints exactly per api-contract.md with tests for success and failure paths.

roles.title: Input Validation Engineer
roles.mission: Add schema based input validation to every endpoint with precise error messages and tests for invalid input.

roles.title: Error Handling Engineer
roles.mission: Implement a consistent error model, central error handler, structured logging of failures and 404 and 500 handling, with tests.

roles.title: API Documentation Engineer
roles.mission: Serve or generate API reference docs from the implemented API and verify they match openapi.yaml.

roles.title: Authentication Engineer
roles.mission: Implement the required authentication flows with salted hashing or a vetted provider, email verification and reset where required, with tests.

roles.title: Authorization Engineer
roles.mission: Implement roles, permissions and ownership checks on every protected resource, with tests that prove denial.

roles.title: Session Security Engineer
roles.mission: Harden sessions or tokens: secure cookies, expiry, rotation, CSRF protection, rate limiting on auth endpoints and security headers.

roles.title: Payments Integrator
roles.mission: Integrate the payment provider behind an adapter with webhook signature verification and idempotency, tested with a fake.

roles.title: Email & Notifications Integrator
roles.mission: Implement transactional email and notifications behind an adapter with templates from copy.md and a console transport for development.

roles.title: File Storage Integrator
roles.mission: Implement file upload and storage behind an adapter with type and size validation and a local disk driver for development.

roles.title: Third Party API Integrator
roles.mission: Integrate any other external API the plan requires behind an adapter with timeouts, retries and a fake for tests.

roles.title: Design Token Engineer
roles.mission: Implement design-spec.md as code level tokens (CSS variables or theme config) including light and dark modes if specified.

roles.title: Component Builder
roles.mission: Build the assigned reusable components with all variants and states, keyboard support and ARIA, plus tests.

roles.title: Layout Shell Engineer
roles.mission: Build the app shell: header, navigation, footer, responsive layout grid and error boundary.

roles.title: Icon & Asset Engineer
roles.mission: Set up the icon system, favicon set, logo placeholder and optimized image handling.

roles.title: Page Builder
roles.mission: Build the assigned pages from sitemap.md using the component library, with loading, empty and error states.

roles.title: Form Builder
roles.mission: Build the assigned forms with client validation matching server validation, accessible errors and submit states.

roles.title: Content Integrator
roles.mission: Place final copy from copy.md into every page and remove all placeholder text.

roles.title: SEO Engineer
roles.mission: Add titles, descriptions, Open Graph tags, canonical URLs, sitemap.xml, robots.txt and structured data where relevant.

roles.title: State Management Engineer
roles.mission: Implement client and server state management with caching and invalidation per the chosen stack.

roles.title: API Client Engineer
roles.mission: Implement a typed API client that matches openapi.yaml, handles auth and errors uniformly, and is shared with mobile when the stack allows.

roles.title: Routing & Guard Engineer
roles.mission: Implement routing, route guards for authenticated and role restricted pages, and redirects, with tests.

roles.title: Android Scaffolder
roles.mission: Scaffold the Android project per stack.md with build configuration, theming from design-spec.md and navigation.

roles.title: Android Screen Builder
roles.mission: Build the assigned Android screens with all states, following platform conventions.

roles.title: Android Data Engineer
roles.mission: Implement the Android networking, persistence and auth token storage wired to the API contract.

roles.title: iOS Scaffolder
roles.mission: Scaffold the iOS project per stack.md with build configuration, theming from design-spec.md and navigation.

roles.title: iOS Screen Builder
roles.mission: Build the assigned iOS screens with all states, following Human Interface Guidelines.

roles.title: iOS Data Engineer
roles.mission: Implement the iOS networking, persistence and Keychain token storage wired to the API contract.

roles.title: Unit Test Engineer
roles.mission: Write unit tests for untested logic in the assigned area, targeting behavior from acceptance-criteria.md.

roles.title: Integration Test Engineer
roles.mission: Write integration tests across API, database and auth for the assigned flows.

roles.title: End to End Test Engineer
roles.mission: Write end to end browser tests (Playwright) for the assigned user flows against a locally started app.

roles.title: Bug Fixer
roles.mission: Reproduce the assigned failing test or defect, find the root cause, fix it at the source and prove the fix with a test. Never weaken or skip a test to make it pass.

roles.title: Dependency Auditor
roles.mission: Run the ecosystem audit tool, upgrade or replace vulnerable dependencies, and record residual findings.

roles.title: Secure Code Reviewer
roles.mission: Review the code for OWASP Top 10 issues (injection, broken access control, XSS, SSRF, insecure deserialization, misconfiguration) and fix confirmed findings with tests.

roles.title: Secrets Scanner
roles.mission: Scan the repository and git history for committed secrets and unsafe config, move values to environment variables and update .env.example.

roles.title: Accessibility Auditor
roles.mission: Audit core flows against WCAG 2.1 AA (automated axe checks plus manual keyboard and semantics review) and fix violations.

roles.title: Performance Auditor
roles.mission: Measure bundle size and page performance, remove waste, add lazy loading and caching, and report before and after numbers.

roles.title: Responsive Layout Checker
roles.mission: Render every page at 360px, 768px and 1280px with Playwright screenshots, fix overflow and layout breakage.

roles.title: Visual Design Reviewer
roles.mission: Start the app, capture Playwright screenshots of every sitemap page at 360px, 768px and 1280px into docs/quality/screenshots/, open each image with the Read tool and judge it against docs/product/design-spec.md: hierarchy, spacing, alignment, contrast, typography, consistency, polish. Fix visual defects in code, re-capture, and write docs/quality/visual-review.md with before and after notes per page.

roles.title: CI Pipeline Engineer
roles.mission: Write the CI workflow (GitHub Actions by default) that installs, lints, typechecks, tests and builds with caching.

roles.title: Containerization Engineer
roles.mission: Write a multi stage Dockerfile, .dockerignore and docker compose for local services, running as a non root user.

roles.title: Release Smoke Verifier
roles.mission: Build the production artifact, start it, and run a scripted smoke test against health and key pages. Report exact results.

roles.title: Deployment Configurator
roles.mission: Write deployment configuration for the hosting target in stack.md and a step by step deploy guide in docs/release/deploy.md.

roles.title: Observability Engineer
roles.mission: Add a health endpoint, structured logging, error reporting hooks and basic request metrics.

roles.title: Deployer
roles.mission: Deploy the product to the hosting target in stack.md when its credentials are present in the environment (for example VERCEL_TOKEN, NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN, FLY_API_TOKEN, RENDER_API_KEY, EXPO_TOKEN for mobile builds), then verify the live URL with an HTTP check of the health endpoint and key pages. When credentials are absent, do not fake it: report the exact variables needed and the one command that will deploy once they are set.
deliverables: live URL verified by HTTP check, or the exact missing credentials and deploy command

roles.title: Documentation Writer
roles.mission: Write README.md (overview, prerequisites, setup, run, test, deploy, structure) and verify each command by running it.
